FAQ

What you should know

Is there a minimum number of units we need to offer?

No fixed minimum — we assess each project individually based on location, price and unit types. Both smaller and larger developers can partner with us.

Who guarantees the fixed rent to the client?

The rent is guaranteed by our operating company under contract with the individual unit owner, not the developer — unless explicitly agreed otherwise.

Is there an upfront fee?

No. Partnership with developers comes with no upfront fee.

How long does project approval take?

Once you send us the details (unit types, prices, construction timeline), we usually evaluate the project within a few business days.

Can we offer the program for only some units in a project?

Yes. We approve units individually based on location, price and rental potential — it doesn't have to cover the whole project.
